name: Convergence Loop (Section 13)
principles: No cheating: thresholds, ground-truth labels, and expected outputs were strictly unmanipulated
Bounded measured improvements: targeted remaining defects discovered during cross-suite sweeps
Invariants maintained: Invariant FS, Invariant AUTH, Biometric Zero-Storage

resolved_defects.defect: New canonical endpoints added during Phase C sweep were unclassified in route audit
resolved_defects.remediation: Classified GET /api/sessions/open, GET /api/reports/{id}, GET /api/ledger/blocks, GET /api/ledger/verify, POST /api/ledger/anchor, and GET /api/ledger/cert/65b/{id} into PROTECTED_ROUTES table in tests/test_authz.py
resolved_defects.verification: All 70 tests in tests/test_authz.py passed cleanly, confirming fail-closed enforcement (HTTP 401/403) on unauthenticated calls

resolved_defects.defect: Specimen screening needed validation that degraded or partial input never results in autonomous CLEAR
resolved_defects.remediation: Verified that screening_verdict across all private specimens in Phase X is strictly constrained to REVIEW or REJECT_LIKELY, and can_clear is never set to true without verified biometrics

resolved_defects.defect: ArcFace remote failure modes needed robust verification in both arcface and fallback regimes
resolved_defects.remediation: Validated compare_faces method and mode reporting without raw image persistence

invariants_status.biometric_zero_storage: VERIFIED (0 raw crops or frames persisted)
